content:
This post change nothing but hey, let's try 

1. Punishing mechanic + More max hp = New dificulty

With each new chapter, enemies gain new "punishing mechanics" and see a massive boost to their health.

This becomes noticeable starting in Chapter 3. Enemies with big max hp pool who can trigger death resist

In Ch4, elite enemies gained tentacles that deal damage every turn - regardless of whether the enemy is currently attacking. Additionally, the "Death Resist" mechanic evolved into "Rebirth" - essentially an enemy-within-an-enemy that clears all negative status effects from itself

Ch5 adds a penalty for playing cards ("Sabotage") on top of the Rebirth mechanic; this can easily escalate to absurd levels. With 90% of your cards affected by Sabotage, you essentially kill yourself just by playing them. Naturally, the question arises: how do you avoid this? You can't. You have to either play the card or destroy it there is no other option. What? You don't want to take 280 damage just to play a defensive card? Too bad - then die from the enemy's attack instead

Ch6 adds enemies that strip away the player's Max HP and Death Resist. On top of that, Pollux, Ghelot, and the final boss feature a mechanic that limits you to playing no more than five cards per turn. Yes, in CARD GAME you cant play card. Also need to remember new Divine ultra(Singulatiry:Ultra) counts as part of that same turn (Enemy clear this stack every turn(5 card for 2 turns...) 

It is also worth mentioning the new spike in enemy damage and Max HP. What used to be a matter of strategy is increasingly turning into a contest of "who has the higher stats." This is especially apparent in the last two released chapters
thread_title: Balance problem in arc2

content:
2. Limitations on tactical choices and team composition. New mechanics don't make game harder, they only punish player for exist and don't offer how to avoid it

2.1 Teams who need time to reach peak power or those relying on survivability always being off meta or close to it. However, as enemy levels rise, the tactic "kill or be killed" dynamic becomes glaringly unavoidable (This is purely my theory, but it seems many combat encounters are increasingly built around a three-turn cycle: hit -> chill -> max power hit. If your team can't eliminate the enemies by the third turn, you’ll likely die)

2.2 Direct damage > DoT. The dev forget about this mechanic and they want you to forget about it too . How? Poison soft and hard cap, nerf counter, also back  to "Revive" in team with direct dmg that's not a big problem but what about units who work with it (like Ghelot/Poison), there are exceptions: Pollux, whose bleed acts as supplementary damage, and Gmurphy who despite relying on sacrifices, can still kill enemy without it 

2.3 Arc1 units need rework.  Tulu, Miryam(one playeble team), Wanda(Rip), Sorel(Rip), Daff(E's before OE  give nothing, 3 cost bad), '24'(Excluding chaos, the other forms are off-meta or worse), Ghelot(only one playeble team), Salvador dps(Rip), Pandia(Rip), Uvhash(Rip)
